# masterdaweb_vpc (Data Source)

Looks up a VPC by its id or its name, or the account's default VPC.

## Example Usage

```terraform
data "masterdaweb_vpc" "default" {
  default = true
}

output "default_subnet" {
  value = data.masterdaweb_vpc.default.subnet
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Optional

- `default` (Boolean) true: the account's default VPC. Give the id, the name, or default = true.
- `id` (String) The VPC's id. Give the id, the name, or default = true.
- `name` (String) The VPC's name, which only it has. Give the id, the name, or default = true.

### Read-Only

- `created_at` (String) When it was created (RFC 3339).
- `description` (String) What the VPC is for.
- `instance_ids` (Set of String) The instances on it.
- `members` (Attributes List) The instances on it, with their private addresses. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--members))
- `region_id` (String) The region it is in.
- `subnet` (String) Its private subnet (CIDR).

<a id="nestedatt--members"></a>
### Nested Schema for `members`

Read-Only:

- `instance_id` (String) The instance.
- `private_ip` (String) Its address on the VPC; null until its private network interface is set up.
- `status` (String) Its private network interface, as last seen.
